name: io.github.zhuyansen/backlink-guard
title: backlink-guard
description: Vet link sources before you submit, verify listings, and audit your backlinks for link spam.

runtimeArguments.name: --with
runtimeArguments.description: backlink-guard itself has no dependencies; the server needs the MCP SDK.

packageArguments.description: Start the MCP server on stdio.

environmentVariables.name: GLASSER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional, the first choice for the paid checks: spam scores, search history, backlinks, competitors' links, AI Overviews.

environmentVariables.name: AISA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The same checks without a Glasser key; the only source of questions, asked and --deep's Ahrefs and Semrush numbers.

environmentVariables.name: GOANYAPI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. A site's rating, a year of visits and whether Google still lists it.

environmentVariables.name: BACKLINK_GUARD_STATE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Absolute path to the directory that holds the log, the cache and the networks seen before.
